algorithm.native: Unchanged original bytes; accept RGB or RGBA only when every alpha is 255. A transparent native is unsupported, never silently flattened. Original image remains unmodified and no Low file is authored.
algorithm.inputs: Same three required distinct paths and scalar constraints as legacy CLI. Validate normal parameters, bounded input bytes, native dimensions, master RGB PNG/aspect/adequate8x and finite float scalar before creating a new output directory.
algorithm.tiers: For Mid4 and High8 independently call unchanged periodic_rgb(master,size) and float_height(scalar,size). Never read another tier.
algorithm.normals: Call unchanged normals_from_height on uncompressed reduced scalar, retaining strength/cap and arithmetic ordering. Do not derive normals from quantized height.
algorithm.heightQuantization: np.round(reducedHeight * 255).astype(uint8); ties-to-even; no scalar quantization before reduction. Record any float32 BOX conversion already performed by shared float_height.
algorithm.normalQuantization: np.round(np.clip(normal * .5 + .5, 0, 1) * 255).astype(uint8), one separate L image for each XYZ component; ties-to-even.
algorithm.encoder: Explicit role whitelist. diffuse calls unchanged legacy encode(image). height/normalX/normalY/normalZ call the same Pillow BytesIO/WebP save architecture with quality=92,lossless=True,method=6. A mask role may share this explicit encoder policy but the CLI has no mask authoring/input path and must not emit or qualify masks.
algorithm.validation: Parse complete RIFF chunks with length/padding checks. Colour requires VP8 and no VP8L; data requires VP8L and no VP8. Decode actual bytes into RGB and compare every data channel with the intended pre-encode L image converted to RGB, including equal R/G/B replication. Require zero mismatches and zero integer compression MAE/max.
algorithm.sourceGuard: Watch original/RGB/NPY input bytes and shared/helper tool bytes; recheck before manifest publication. Retain partial new directory on failure as evidence, without a success manifest. Existing master.json producer pins stay untouched.
algorithm.diagnostics: Retain half/quarter BOX colour comparisons, edges and three normal-angle diagnostics. Separate float-to8 quantization from compression error: data compression is exact; quantization and angular error can remain nonzero.

manifestContract.outputs: Same ten filenames/roles/dimensions and input sourceMaster binding; each row repeats its own encoding and actual byte hash/count. Include inputMode L/RGB, bitsPerChannel8, intendedRGB8Sha256, decodedRGB8Sha256 and exactDecodedChannelValues for data roles. Colour exact pixel equality is not required.
manifestContract.quantization: Per tier: explicit formula/rounding/float reduction stages; heightFloatTo8 MAE/max; normalXYZFloatTo8 diagnostics; per-data-role compressionMismatchCount=0,compressionMAE8=0,compressionMax8=0. Keep heightQuantizationCompressionMAE only as an accurately described aggregate diagnostic, never evidence of compression loss.
manifestContract.batchDescriptor: Retain schema2 repository-path/native/master/tiers shape; remove contradictory global lossless/quality blanket fields and replace with encodingByRole for exactly emitted roles. Bind new tier manifest path/hash, original and unchanged master-package path/hash. No mask/native alpha qualification.
manifestContract.review: New Quake entry validates schema3, factors4/8, defaultMid, exact five emitted roles, paths contained in repository, per-role policy and bound manifest/output hashes/RIFF/decode before output. Calls existing build for each item; writes mixed-codec HTML stating colour Q92 and data lossless. Existing shared review CLI stays unchanged and continues schema2 legacy replay.

checks: Check all protectedSourceBindings unchanged before/after. Snapshot every current Quake and Hexen master.json SHA; no mutations allowed.
Run unchanged legacy public CLI suite and boundary/layered/motif tests; all source-path/hash tamper rejection tests remain enabled.

Replay a historical all-lossy fixture and retained actual legacy manifest from masters; compare all ten files, manifest source/tool claims and review sheets/HTML byte-for-byte under the recorded environment.

New public subprocess test uses non-square >8x fixture, integer-footprint scalar averaging oracle and independent cyclic normal formulas already established in tests/hexen2_texture_tiers_test.py; it must not call production reduction/normal helpers for expected output.

Compare diffuse bytes exactly with legacy Q92/method6; independently encode all four data roles losslessly; parse RIFF and compare decoded full RGB arrays exactly to intended quantized arrays for both tiers.

Include values at quantization ties/endpoints and float64 inputs; prove zero compression error while reporting nonzero scalar quantization. Verify all metadata/hashes/dimensions/normal angular diagnostics.
Use high-frequency scalar fixture that gives different normals after height quantization; expected normals must match uncompressed scalar and differ from the quantized-height alternative.
Show Mid differs from re-encoding decoded High, and High differs from upscaled decoded Mid.

Reject unknown roles, transparent native, nonRGB master, undersized/aspect-mismatched master, invalid/NaN/Fortran/trailing NPY, nonfinite strength/cap, equal input paths and existing/symlink output. Verify original/master/scalar hashes unchanged and no Low output.
If mask is present in encoder role whitelist, test it as lossless encoder-only and explicitly assert no CLI mask output or native mask qualification.
After synthetic code qualification, independently replay source/native/prompt/master hashes and unchanged producer pins for all five existing tier candidates listed below.

Produce new outputs directly from retained RGB/NPY; ten files per material. Both diffuse files must remain byte-identical to each material legacy diffuse under same parameters/environment. All eight data maps per material must have exact decoded intended8-bit channels.

For church1/maya1_9 retain existing source/art evidence and rerender affected decoded data/lighting reviews; for city8_2/rock3_2/wwall1_1 preserve their separate coordinator art/edge findings. A codec PASS never promotes an art HOLD.
Compare all retained legacy bytes/receipts/masters and entire separate Hexen snapshot unchanged. Keep cop2_5/metal9_4 relief holds; do not fabricate candidate tiers for them.

Test new mixed-codec review through subprocess and verify panels are decoded actual new map pixels using existing review tests/oracles; verify exact map-manifest bindings and reject contradictory codec/missing role/path escape/tampered maps.
